lines.t: Until I give up, I can't find success
Letting go of all I hold so tight
Everything I grip must pass away
What did you withhold in your passion?
You were destroyed because of love
Gave up everything because of love
And so I must let myself be undone by love
I cry, I will, I come undone
No more walls, nothing left to hide
Are you my one and only, my burning passion?
Does my heart burn at the mention of your name?
Do tears fall when I remember your love?
Can I admit when I'm apart I'm undone?
I keep letting thoughts of sin in my mind
It wants to devour what's left of me
I'm the only one who stands in the way
Let me in, fill my heart with peace
This pain, it won't last forever
Pride speaks through my foolish mouth
Somewhere deep I know what's true, you call me your own
Let me return as a child taken, hidden, drinking deep of grace
Healed every rent in my heart, made whole, love remains steady, unchanging
Yeah, who's sure you still remain
